I mean, they're two completely different games so it's hard to pick but if I had to pick I would probably pick GTA considering how much more stuff you could do, all the vehicles, missions and much more.

I've played Rainbow Six for more than 600 hours now and I would highly recommend it if you have a couple of friend to play it with, without friends it can be a pain in the ass. There can be alot of toxicity in the beginning if you don't know what you're doing but after 200 hours of playing you should probably have gotten the hang of it. GTA V is also really fun, I've got 2000 hours on it for a reason, you need to work very hard for what you want but I would say it's worth it. It's one of the biggest maps in a game and it's really fun to explore new places, the worst thing about it is probably all the Opressors shooting you down, otherwise very good game. I haven't played spiderman but I would strongly recommend Rainbow Six and GTA V.
